tags.description: The API Endpoints for the Gateway Templates at the site level can be used to get the site derived networks, meaning the org level configuration with the site variables resolved..
tags.name: Sites Gateway Templates

get.description: Get the list of derived Gateway Templates a Site

additional_config_cmds.description: additional CLI commands to append to the generated Junos config. **Note**: no check is done

items.description: JUNOS "set" command to add to the generated configuration

allow_deny.description: Policy action value that either allows or denies matching traffic. enum: `allow`, `deny`

app_probing.description: Application reachability probing settings for gateway management

enabled.description: Whether gateway application probing is enabled

address.description: Required if `protocol`==`icmp`. IP address probed by the ICMP custom app

app_type.description: Category label used for this custom application probe

hostnames.description: If `protocol`==`http`. Hostnames or URLs probed by this custom app

key.description: Stable key used to identify this custom application probe

name.description: Display name for this custom application probe

network.description: Gateway network used as the source context for this probe

packetSize.description: If `protocol`==`icmp`. ICMP packet size used by this custom app probe

protocol.description: Probe protocol used by this custom application definition

url.description: If `protocol`==`http`. HTTP URL or hostname probed by this custom app

vrf.description: Gateway VRF used as the source context for this probe

app_probing_custom_app_hostname.description: If `protocol`==`http`. HTTP hostnames or URLs probed by the custom app

app_probing_custom_app_protocol.description: Probe protocol for a custom application. enum: `http`, `icmp`

bgp_as.description: BGP AS, value in range 1-4294967294. Can be a Variable (e.g. `{{bgp_as}}` )

bgp_config.description: BGP session configuration. BFD is enabled when either bfd_minimum_interval or bfd_multiplier is configured

bfd_minimum_interval.description:
Optional if `via`==`lan`, `via`==`tunnel` or `via`==`wan`, when bfd_multiplier is configured alone. Default:
  * 1000 if `type`==`external`
  * 350 `type`==`internal`

bfd_multiplier.description: Optional if `via`==`lan`, `via`==`tunnel` or `via`==`wan`, when bfd_minimum_interval_is_configured alone

disable_bfd.description: Optional if `via`==`lan`, `via`==`tunnel` or `via`==`wan`. BFD provides faster path failure detection and is enabled by default

export.description: Routing policy applied to routes exported by this BGP session

export_policy.description: Default export policies if no per-neighbor policies defined

extended_v4_nexthop.description: Optional if `via`==`lan`, `via`==`tunnel` or `via`==`wan`. By default, either inet/net6 unicast depending on neighbor IP family (v4 or v6). For v6 neighbors, to exchange v4 nexthop, which allows dual-stack support, enable this

import.description: Routing policy applied to routes imported by this BGP session

import_policy.description: Optional if `via`==`lan`, `via`==`tunnel` or `via`==`wan`. Default import policies if no per-neighbor policies defined

local_as.description: Required if `via`==`lan`, `via`==`tunnel` or `via`==`wan`; local BGP Autonomous System (AS) number

neighbor_as.description: Default BGP neighbor Autonomous System (AS) number for this session

neighbors.description: Required if `via`==`lan`, `via`==`tunnel` or `via`==`wan`. If per-neighbor as is desired. Property key is the neighbor address

networks.description: Optional if `via`==`lan`; networks where BGP neighbors can connect to or from

no_private_as.description: Optional if `via`==`lan`, `via`==`tunnel` or `via`==`wan`. If true, we will not advertise private ASNs (AS 64512-65534) to this neighbor

no_readvertise_to_overlay.description: Optional if `via`==`lan`, `via`==`tunnel` or `via`==`wan`. By default, we'll re-advertise all learned BGP routers toward overlay

tunnel_name.description: Optional if `via`==`tunnel`; tunnel name used for this BGP session

type.description: Required if `via`==`lan`, `via`==`tunnel` or `via`==`wan`; BGP session type, internal or external

via.description: Transport used for this BGP session, such as LAN, tunnel, VPN, or WAN

vpn_name.description: Optional if `via`==`vpn`; VPN name used for this BGP session

wan_name.description: Optional if `via`==`wan`; WAN interface name used for this BGP session

disabled.description: If true, the BGP session to this neighbor will be administratively disabled/shutdown

export_policy.description: Export policy applied only to this BGP neighbor

hold_time.description: BGP hold time for this neighbor, in seconds

import_policy.description: Import policy applied only to this BGP neighbor

multihop_ttl.description: Assuming BGP neighbor is directly connected

neighbor_as.description: Autonomous System (AS) number of this BGP neighbor

tunnel_via.description: If `via`==`tunnel`, primary or secondary tunnel associated with this BGP neighbor

bgp_config_networks.description: Optional if `via`==`lan`. List of networks where we expect BGP neighbor to connect to/from

bgp_local_as.description: Required if `via`==`lan`, `via`==`tunnel` or `via`==`wan`. BGP AS, value in range 1-4294967295

created_time.description: When the object has been created, in epoch

dhcpd_config.description: DHCP server configuration map with a global enable flag

enabled.description: If set to `false`, disable the DHCP server

dhcpd_config_dns_servers.description: If `type`==`local` or `type6`==`local` - optional, if not defined, system one will be used

dhcpd_config_dns_suffix.description: If `type`==`local` or `type6`==`local` - optional, if not defined, system one will be used

dhcpd_config_fixed_binding.description: Static DHCP binding for a client MAC address

ip.description: Reserved IPv4 address for this fixed DHCP binding

ip6.description: Reserved IPv6 address for this fixed DHCP binding

name.description: Friendly name for this fixed DHCP binding

dhcpd_config_fixed_bindings.description: If `type`==`local` or `type6`==`local`. Property key is the client MAC address. Format is `[0-9a-f]{12}` (e.g. "5684dae9ac8b")

type.description: Data type used to encode this DHCP option value

value.description: Option value to send for this DHCP option

dhcpd_config_options.description: If `type`==`local` or `type6`==`local`. Property key is the DHCP option number

dhcpd_config_property.description: DHCP server or relay configuration for one network

dns_servers.description: If `type`==`local` or `type6`==`local`, DNS servers advertised to DHCP clients

dns_suffix.description: If `type`==`local` or `type6`==`local`, DNS search suffixes advertised to DHCP clients

fixed_bindings.description: If `type`==`local` or `type6`==`local`, fixed client bindings for local DHCP service

gateway.description: If `type`==`local` - optional, `ip` will be used if not provided

ip6_end.description: If `type6`==`local`, ending IPv6 address for the DHCP lease pool

ip6_start.description: If `type6`==`local`, starting IPv6 address for the DHCP lease pool

ip_end.description: If `type`==`local`, ending IPv4 address for the DHCP lease pool

ip_start.description: If `type`==`local`, starting IPv4 address for the DHCP lease pool

lease_time.description: In seconds, lease time has to be between 3600 [1hr] - 604800 [1 week], default is 86400 [1 day]

options.description: If `type`==`local` or `type6`==`local`, custom DHCP options advertised to clients

server_id_override.description:
`server_id_override`==`true` means the device, when acts as DHCP relay and forwards DHCP responses from DHCP server to clients, 
should overwrite the Sever Identifier option (i.e. DHCP option 54) in DHCP responses with its own IP address.

type.description: IPv4 DHCP mode for this network

type6.description: IPv6 DHCP mode for this network

vendor_encapsulated.description: If `type`==`local` or `type6`==`local`, vendor-encapsulated DHCP options advertised to clients

type.description: Data type used to encode this vendor option value

value.description: Option value to send for this vendor option

dhcpd_config_vendor_options.description:
If `type`==`local` or `type6`==`local`. Property key is <enterprise number>:<sub option code>, with
  * enterprise number: 1-65535 (https://www.iana.org/assignments/enterprise-numbers/enterprise-numbers)
  * sub option code: 1-255, sub-option code

dns_servers.description: Global dns settings. To keep compatibility, dns settings in `ip_config` and `oob_ip_config` will overwrite this setting

dns_suffix.description: Global dns settings. To keep compatibility, dns settings in `ip_config` and `oob_ip_config` will overwrite this setting

gateway_extra_route6.description: Gateway IPv6 extra route next-hop settings

app_usage.description: Consumes uplink bandwidth, requires WA license

gateway_mgmt_admin_sshkeys.description: For SSR only, as direct root access is not allowed

time_of_day.description: Optional, Mist will decide the timing

gateway_mgmt_probe_hosts.description: IPv4 probe hosts used for gateway connectivity checks

gateway_mgmt_probe_hostsv6.description: IPv6 probe hosts used for gateway connectivity checks

gateway_oob_ip_config.description: Out-of-band management IP configuration for gateway interfaces such as vme, em0, or fxp0

gateway_path_preferences.description: Gateway path preference that selects among one or more local, WAN, VPN, or tunnel paths

paths.description: Candidate paths evaluated for this gateway path preference

strategy.description: Selection strategy used to evaluate the candidate paths

gateway_path_preferences_path.description: Candidate path within a gateway path preference

cost.description: Relative cost assigned to this path for gateway path selection

disabled.description: For SSR Only. `true`, if this specific path is undesired

gateway_ip.description: Only if `type`==`local`, if a different gateway is desired

internet_access.description: Only if `type`==`vpn`, if this vpn path can be used for internet

name.description:
Required when 
  * `type`==`vpn`: the name of the VPN Path to use 
  * `type`==`wan`: the name of the WAN interface to use

networks.description: List of network names used when `type`==`local`

target_ips.description: List of destination IP addresses to replace when `type`==`local`

gateway_port_config.description: Gateway port configuration for LAN, WAN, tunnel, and HA interfaces

ae_disable_lacp.description: If `aggregated`==`true`. To disable LCP support for the AE interface

ae_idx.description: If `aggregated`==`true`. Users could force to use the designated AE name (must be an integer between 0 and 127)

ae_lacp_force_up.description: For SRX only, if `aggregated`==`true`.Sets the state of the interface as UP when the peer has limited LACP capability. Use case: When a device connected to this AE port is ZTPing for the first time, it will not have LACP configured on the other end. **Note:** Turning this on will enable force-up on one of the interfaces in the bundle only

aggregated.description: Whether the port participates in an aggregated Ethernet interface

critical.description: To generate port up/down alarm, set it to true

description.description: Interface Description. Can be a variable (i.e. "{{myvar}}")

disable_autoneg.description: Whether Ethernet autonegotiation is disabled on the port

dsl_type.description: If `wan_type`==`dsl`. DSL technology used by the WAN port

duplex.description: Ethernet duplex mode configured on the port

ip_config.description: Layer 3 IP configuration for the port

lte_apn.description: If `wan_type`==`lte`. APN used by the LTE uplink

lte_auth.description: If `wan_type`==`lte`. Authentication method used by the LTE uplink

lte_backup.description: Whether the LTE uplink is used as a backup WAN connection

lte_password.description: If `wan_type`==`lte`. Password used for LTE uplink authentication

lte_username.description: If `wan_type`==`lte`. Username used for LTE uplink authentication

mtu.description: Layer 3 MTU configured on the port

name.description: Interface name used to derive device configuration

networks.description: If `usage`==`lan`. Networks attached to the interface

outer_vlan_id.description: For Q-in-Q. Outer VLAN ID used for QinQ encapsulation

poe_disabled.description: Whether PoE output is disabled on the port

poe_keep_state_when_reboot.description: Whether Perpetual PoE capabilities are enabled for a port

port_network.description: Only for SRX and if `usage`==`lan`, the name of the Network to be used as the Untagged VLAN

preserve_dscp.description: Whether to preserve dscp when sending traffic over VPN (SSR-only)

redundant.description: If HA mode. Whether the port participates in the redundant Ethernet configuration

redundant_group.description: If HA mode, SRX Only - support redundancy-group. 1-128 for physical SRX, 1-64 for virtual SRX

reth_idx.description: If HA mode and for SRX only. Redundant Ethernet interface index assigned to the port

reth_node.description: If HA mode. Node associated with the redundant Ethernet interface

reth_nodes.description: If HA mode and for SSR only. Per-network node assignment used for VLAN-based redundancy

speed.description: Link speed configured on the port

ssr_no_virtual_mac.description: When SSR is running as VM, this is required on certain hosting platforms

svr_port_range.description: For SSR only. Port range configured on the interface

traffic_shaping.description: Traffic shaping settings applied to the port

usage.description: Logical usage assigned to the port

vlan_id.description: VLAN ID or variable used when the WAN interface is carried on a VLAN

vpn_paths.description: Per-VPN path settings for traffic that uses this port

wan_arp_policer.description: Only when `wan_type`==`broadband`. ARP policer profile applied to the WAN port

wan_ext_ip.description: Only if `usage`==`wan`, optional. If spoke should reach this port by a different IP

wan_ext_ip6.description: Only if `usage`==`wan`, optional. If spoke should reach this port by a different IPv6

wan_extra_routes.description: Only if `usage`==`wan`. Property Key is the destination CIDR (e.g. "100.100.100.0/24")

wan_extra_routes6.description: Only if `usage`==`wan`. Property Key is the destination CIDR (e.g. "2a02:1234:420a:10c9::/64")

wan_networks.description: Only if `usage`==`wan`. Networks reachable through this WAN port for policy definition

wan_probe_override.description: Optional WAN health probe override settings for this port

wan_type.description: Only if `usage`==`wan`. WAN uplink type configured on the port

gateway_port_config_ip_config.description: Junos IP configuration for a gateway port interface

dns.description: Resolver server IP addresses used by this interface, except on out-of-band interfaces such as vme, em0, or fxp0

dns_suffix.description: DNS search suffixes used by this interface, except on out-of-band interfaces such as vme, em0, or fxp0

netmask6.description: Used only if `subnet` is not specified in `networks`. Interface IPv6 Netmask (i.e. "/64") or a Variable (i.e. "{{myvar}}")

pppoe_auth.description: Authentication protocol used for PPPoE when `type`==`pppoe`

type6.description: IPv6 assignment mode for this gateway port interface

bfd_profile.description: BFD profile used for this VPN path when the VPN `type`==`hub_spoke`

bfd_use_tunnel_mode.description: Only if the VPN `type`==`hub_spoke`. Whether to use tunnel mode. SSR only

preference.description: Only if the VPN `type`==`hub_spoke`. For a given VPN, when `path_selection.strategy`==`simple`, the preference for a path (lower is preferred)

apiToken.description:
Preferred authentication method for automation and integrations. Send the API token in the HTTP `Authorization` header.

**Format**:
  `Authorization: Token {apitoken}`

**Notes**:
* An API token generated for a specific admin has the same privileges as that admin
* An API token is automatically removed if it is not used for more than 90 days
* SSO admins cannot generate admin API tokens. Use organization API tokens when scoped Org/Site privileges are needed.
apiToken.name: Authorization

csrfToken.description:
Session-based authentication for browser or login/password flows. After a successful [Login](/#operations/login) request, Mist returns a `csrftoken` cookie. Send that value in the `X-CSRFToken` header on later API requests that use the login session.

**Format**:
```
X-CSRFToken: vwvBuq9qkqaKh7lu8tNc0gkvBfEaLAmx
```

For automation, API Token authentication is preferred.
csrfToken.name: X-CSRFToken
